criteria.requirement: Implement ftfy.atomic.fix_file_atomic(source,destination=None,*,encoding="utf-8",config=None,max_line_length=1000000) and frozen FileRepairResult(input_chars,output_chars,changed). Read strict explicit encoding in bounded chunks, reuse completed fix_chunks including whole-file HTML policy, write UTF8 to same-directory temp, flush/fsync and replace only on full success. Support in-place and separate output, preserve existing output permissions; decode/budget/source/write/replace errors leave old output unchanged and remove temps. Reject symlink/nonfile paths. Changed compares text, not source encoding bytes; no encoding guessing or whole-file buffering.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
